build_convnet_layer: build a ConvNet layer with specified input channels, output channels, and kernel size
create_flatten_layer: create a Flatten layer that collapses all dimensions except batch into a single dimension
test_unflatten_layer: test the UnFlatten layer to reshape a flattened tensor back to specified dimensions
build_mlp_classifier: build an MLP classifier layer with configurable hidden dimensions and number of layers
create_bert_classifier_head: create a BERT classifier head with GELU activation, layer norm, and dropout config
